rows.symptom: Could not start on port 8080
rows.cause: Another program is using the port.
rows.fix: Set PORT in .env to a free port and start again.

rows.symptom: 421 Unexpected Host header
rows.cause: The site was opened under a name the server does not know (an IP, a domain).
rows.fix: Use localhost, or add the name to ALLOWED_HOSTS in .env and restart.

rows.symptom: A page is a 404, or the server says the pages are missing
rows.cause: pages/ has not been built.
rows.fix: npm run build:site. npm start does this for you when pages are missing.

rows.symptom: The Design Studio misbehaves when a page is opened by double-clicking it
rows.cause: From file:// the Studio's in-browser vision worker can fail to start, which silently drops it to a much coarser fallback.
rows.fix: Open the site through the server (http://localhost:8080).

rows.symptom: The Studio says the model service is not available, or /api/segment answers 503 UNAVAILABLE
rows.cause: The Python service is still starting, was not found, is switched off, or crashed. The message says which.
rows.fix: Wait a moment if it says starting. If Python is missing packages: npm run setup:model (or set PYTHON to an interpreter that has them). To see Python's own errors: npm run model.

rows.symptom: model.status is unavailable in /api/config and the reason mentions a timeout
rows.cause: Python did not print its READY line within MODEL_START_TIMEOUT seconds (90 by default), for example on a slow first start while its libraries load. The service is then reported unavailable and not restarted in a loop.
rows.fix: Raise MODEL_START_TIMEOUT and restart Express. SAM, if enabled, loads in the background after READY, so it does not count towards this timeout.

rows.symptom: The service keeps restarting
rows.cause: It exits right after starting. After 5 tries in 10 minutes Express gives up and stays unavailable with the reason.
rows.fix: Run npm run model in a terminal and read the error. Restart Express after fixing it.

rows.symptom: I want to run the model service somewhere else (a GPU machine)
rows.fix: On that machine: MODEL_HOST, MODEL_PORT and MODEL_SERVICE_KEY, then npm run model. Here: MODEL_SERVICE=external, MODEL_SERVICE_URL and the same MODEL_SERVICE_KEY.

rows.symptom: "The Terucon server is running but has no Google credentials yet" / scans answer 503 FAILED_PRECONDITION
rows.cause: No credentials in .env.
rows.fix: Fill in GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON (or GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS) and GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT, or GEMINI_API_KEY. Save and reload the page. No restart is needed.

rows.symptom: "The Vertex AI API is turned off for project ..."
rows.cause: aiplatform.googleapis.com is not enabled.
rows.fix: Enable it in the Cloud console and wait a minute.

rows.symptom: "... is not allowed to call ..."
rows.cause: The service account lacks a role.
rows.fix: Give it Vertex AI User (roles/aiplatform.user).

rows.symptom: "... is not available in location ..." or a 404 for a model
rows.cause: The model is not offered in that location to your project.
rows.fix: GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION=global, or set the model in .env. The terminal shows each model tried.

rows.symptom: "Google rejected the token time"
rows.cause: The computer's clock is wrong.
rows.fix: Turn on automatic date and time.

rows.symptom: "GCP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON ... not valid JSON"
rows.cause: The key was pasted over several lines or without quotes.
rows.fix: The whole key on one line, inside single quotes (they keep the \n in the private key intact).

rows.symptom: SAM: error ... in the Studio's settings or /api/sam/health
rows.cause: A missing package (torch, transformers), a gated model, or no GPU for SAM 3.
rows.fix: The message says which: pip install -r model/requirements-sam.txt, set HF_TOKEN, or use a GPU machine (SAM_BACKEND=sam3 / SAM_REMOTE_URL).

rows.symptom: Edges look worse than before on some photos
rows.cause: Contour snapping misjudged an image.
rows.fix: Set EDGE_METHOD=watershed in .env (the earlier method) and reload, or EDGE_REFINE=false to switch snapping off. The Studio's footer names what ran.

rows.symptom: Surfaces look coarse, and the footer says "SegFormer ... on WASM"
rows.cause: The in-browser fallback ran because the server engine failed.
rows.fix: Read the Studio's notes toast and the terminal for why: Google not configured, the model service unavailable, a quota.

rows.symptom: "Edge snapping was skipped for N outlines"
rows.cause: It ran out of its 8 second budget or hit an error on those surfaces.
rows.fix: They keep the outline as drawn. The terminal says why. Lower ANALYSIS_MAX_SIDE to speed it up.

rows.symptom: npm run build:site fails with "anchor matched 0 times"
rows.cause: A re-exported page changed in a way a patch cannot follow. It fails on purpose rather than half-patching.
rows.fix: Open the step named in the message in site/patches/<page>.json and update its anchor to the new export.

rows.symptom: Some images on the Materials page are blank
rows.cause: That page asks for media/materials/*.jpg, which has not been added yet.
rows.fix: Add the photos to media/materials/. They are served at /media/materials/.

rows.symptom: npm test fails at "the project overview matches the tree"
rows.cause: A file, route or variable was added or removed without describing it here, or a file changed since this page was generated.
rows.fix: The message lists what disagrees. Edit docs/overview/catalog/*.json, then npm run build:overview and commit docs/PROJECT_OVERVIEW.html.
